title: Integrability of a Gaussian density product
statement: If $u:\mathbb R\to\mathbb R$ is integrable under the standard Gaussian probability measure $\gamma$, then the function $x\mapsto\varphi(x)u(x)$ is integrable with respect to Lebesgue measure, where $\varphi$ is the standard Gaussian density.
hypotheses_covered: $u$ is integrable under the standard Gaussian measure
